recognize_zh: CD33 免疫染色中，幾乎所有大型腫瘤細胞都呈強而瀰漫的細胞膜與細胞質陽性，細胞膜輪廓清楚，排成類似巢狀的結構；強 CD33 表現確認腫瘤為骨髓系（myeloid）來源，支持髓樣肉瘤。
features: Nearly all tumor cells show strong, diffuse CD33 staining
Crisp membranous accentuation outlining cell borders, plus granular cytoplasmic staining
Large cells with oval nuclei arranged in vague nests and cords
Nuclei appear pale and unstained, confirming non-nuclear localization
Intervening stroma and vessels are largely negative
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD33 shows strong and diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in nearly all of the large neoplastic cells. The staining outlines cell borders and highlights a vaguely nested growth pattern, with intervening stroma negative. This strong expression of a myeloid-associated antigen, together with CD34 negativity and the large epithelioid morphology, supports myeloid lineage. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma in a patient with AML with monocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Histiocytic sarcoma may show some CD33 but is defined by CD163/CD68/lysozyme expression without an associated AML or blast phenotype.
BPDCN has skin-predominant blastoid cells that are CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, and TCF4+, usually lacking strong CD33 and lysozyme.
Carcinoma is keratin positive and CD33 negative, despite a similar nested membrane pattern.
